# z-image — prompting & settings guide

- **Prompting style:** natural_language
- **Negative prompt:** ignored — do not pass one
- **Prompt weights** (e.g. `(word:1.2)`): not honored
- **Loader:** UNETLoader + CLIPLoader

## Recommended settings

| steps | cfg | sampler | scheduler | resolution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 8 | 1 | euler | simple | 1024x1024 |

## Tips

- Z-Image Turbo is a distilled few-step model — ~8 steps at cfg 1.0 is the intended operating point.
- Describe the scene in natural language; it follows full sentences well.
- Great speed/quality tradeoff for quick iterations — keep settings light.

## Common mistakes

- Don't raise cfg above 1 or add a negative prompt — the turbo distillation expects guidance-free sampling.
- Don't run 20-30 steps; this is an 8-step model and extra steps waste time without quality gains.

## Example prompt

> A minimalist still life of three ripe persimmons on a pale linen cloth, soft diffused window light, muted autumn palette, clean and serene.
